Have someone teach the “Hand Gospel”
What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(Priesthood of all Believers – Samaritan Woman)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
The church is a group of people who worship and serve Jesus together. The Bible shows us that it is best to have a pastor (shepherd) lead each church.
Titus 1:5
1 Timothy 3:1-7 (Qualifications for Pastors)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
God desires for every church to have a pastor (shepherd).
A pastor should be a man who will shepherd the church.
To be a pastor you do not need to go to Bible College.
A pastor must meet the qualifications found in 1 Timothy 3:1-7 and Titus 1:5-10.
The qualifications are focused on a man’s character, but he should be able to teach and should not be a recent convert.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
As a group, focus on the qualifications of a pastor.
Does someone in this group meet these qualifications?
If yes, help them appoint someone to begin leading this group. He must meet the qualifications found in the Scriptures.
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Note: If the group appoints a pastor, spend extra time discipling him so that he can begin shepherding this group with God’s Word.
Vision Casting
One day every nation (ethnic group), tribe, people and language will stand before the throne of God in worship. Let’s commit to take the Gospel to everyone
Revelation 7:9-10
Pray
If no one meets the qualifications, ask God to raise up someone to lead. If there is someone in the group who meets these qualifications, pray for them to lead Christ’s Church for God’s glory.
